errors.text_span: 约在句子1到3之间快速上升至基线上方并接近图中上部（旁注“喜爱”位于高位区间）
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the curve approaches its upper part between sentences 1 and 3, and incorrectly associates the annotation “喜爱” (love/like) with this early rising phase. In the figure, the curve is still far from its peak at sentence 3, and the annotation “喜爱” is located at the peak of the curve, around sentences 7-10.

errors.text_span: 随后从约句子3一直到约句子12–13维持在高位平台
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the high-level plateau phase begins at sentence 3. According to the figure, the curve is still rising steeply at sentence 3 and only begins to level off into the plateau/peak phase around sentence 4 or 5.
